segments.name: Retail Annuities
segments.description: Offers retirement income and savings annuities, including variable, registered index-linked, fixed and payout annuities, to U.S. retail investors and retirement savers.
segments.evidence: The Company's Retail Annuities segment offers a variety of retirement income and savings products through its diverse suite of products, consisting primarily of variable annuities, registered index-linked annuities ("RILA"), fixed annuities, fixed index annuities, and payout annuities.

segments.name: Institutional Products
products: Funding agreements backed by medium-term notes
Funding agreements backed by commercial paper
segments.description: Issues guaranteed investment contracts and funding agreements to institutional investors, earning a spread between investment returns and credited interest.
segments.evidence: financial results of the Company's institutional products business are primarily dependent on the Company's ability to earn a spread between earned investment rates on general account assets and the interest credited on GICs and funding agreements.

segments.name: Closed Life and Annuity Blocks
products: fixed, fixed index, and payout annuities
segments.description: Operates blocks of acquired life insurance and annuity business, including protection products, that the company no longer actively sells.
segments.evidence: The Company's Closed Life and Annuity Blocks segment is primarily composed of blocks of business that have been acquired since 2004.

revenueModel.text: Retail annuity customers pay fees, and institutional clients pay for funding agreements and guaranteed investment contracts, while the company also earns investment income.
revenueModel.evidence: We earn revenues predominantly from fee income, income from investments, and insurance premiums.
